related_resources.reason: February 2015 edition; small-impairment evaluation with controlled listener methods. Not an aesthetic music-ranking standard.
October 2015 edition; formal intermediate-quality audio evaluation (MUSHRA family), not compositional preference measurement.
Approved January 2019; official recommendation. General subjective sound-quality evaluation, not aesthetic authority for musical composition.
Official summary of assessment environment for programme selection and sound-control rooms; 1998 edition predates current loudness normalization guidance.

Journal of the Audio Engineering Society 51(9):806-825, 2003. Public abstract reports controlled loudspeaker evaluations of trained and untrained listener groups; full journal article may require access.
November 2023 edition; standard loudness and true-peak algorithms. Free official download; consult full normative annex for implementation details.
DawDreamer graph-mixer APIs, built-in filters, compressors, reverbs and oscillator testing.
Export report with peak, true peak and integrated loudness, as well as output formats and ranges.

citation_policy: Source IDs identify the original article/standard/book and the supported claim with locator or abstract scope. Original calculations and teaching examples remain explicitly authored. Anchors must be exact narration substrings; mechanical checks cannot confirm source interpretation.
